bull.b: Raised $11.5M materially lengthened cash runway, reducing near-term financing pressure and giving management time to execute clinical pilots, prototype commercialization and initial sales efforts. This funding durability supports progress on regulatory and commercialization milestones over months.

Two existing FDA clearances provide a durable regulatory foothold enabling limited commercial activity today and a clearer pathway for label expansion. This regulatory track record reduces technical/regulatory execution risk when pursuing broader MI indications and partnerships.

A partnership with Mount Sinai strengthens clinical credibility and accelerates algorithm development using institutional data and expertise. This builds a sustainable technological moat for AI-driven diagnostics and supports future regulatory submissions and commercial differentiation.

bear.b: The company lacks commercial traction and generates no recurring revenue while burning significant cash. Sustained negative operating and free cash flow create ongoing financing dependency, limiting strategic optionality and making long-term execution contingent on successful fundraising or rapid commercialization.

Severe decline in shareholder equity reflects accumulated losses and reduces balance-sheet shock absorption. A thin equity base constrains borrowing capacity, raises vulnerability to adverse events, and increases likelihood of dilutive financing, affecting long-term financial flexibility and strategic execution.

A listing non-compliance notice is a structural governance and financing risk: potential delisting would impair liquidity, investor access and could complicate capital raises or partnerships. Managing the compliance timeline diverts management focus and heightens execution risk over the medium term.
